attributes.label: Post Type
attributes.help: Choose which post type the grid pulls from.

attributes.label: Display Posts
attributes.help: Choose whether selected entries or their children are shown.

attributes.label: Posts per Page
attributes.help: How many entries one page of the grid shows.

attributes.label: Order by
attributes.help: Choose the field the entries are sorted by.

attributes.label: Order
attributes.help: Choose the sort direction.

attributes.label: Include Pagination
attributes.help: Show page links below the grid.

attributes.label: Pagination Colour
attributes.help: Choose the button colour of the page links.

attributes.label: Layout
attributes.help: Arrangement of the entries. Masonry lets single entries span two grid columns instead of one.

attributes.label: Container width
attributes.help: Bootstrap container class that limits the width of the grid inside the block.

attributes.label: Columns
attributes.help: Number of columns the grid grows to on wide screens. Below 576 px it always shows a single column.

attributes.label: Show heading
attributes.help: Shows a heading above the grid. It is only rendered once the heading text below is filled in.

attributes.label: Heading
attributes.help: Text of the heading above the grid.

attributes.label: Heading level
attributes.help: Heading level the text above the grid is rendered as.

attributes.label: Heading color
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap text-color utility class to the heading above the grid.

attributes.label: Show intro
attributes.help: Shows an intro above the grid. Note: while the heading switch is on, a filled-in intro is rendered even with this switch off.

attributes.label: Intro
attributes.help: Text of the intro above the grid.

attributes.label: Intro color
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap text-color utility class to the intro above the grid.

attributes.label: Include Media
attributes.help: Show the featured image of each entry.

attributes.label: Include Title
attributes.help: Show the title of each entry.

attributes.label: Title Element
attributes.help: Choose the heading level of the entry title.

attributes.label: Include Excerpt
attributes.help: Show the excerpt of each entry.

attributes.label: Include Permalink
attributes.help: Make the whole entry a link to the post.

attributes.label: Item style
attributes.help: Passed on to the images: Full removes their padding.

attributes.label: Item size
attributes.help: Height of the inline media of each entry: Small is 20vh, Medium is 30vh. Large carries no rule of its own and keeps the default of 40vh.

attributes.label: Card Size
attributes.help: Choose the size of the entry cards.

attributes.label: Text utilities
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap text-color utility class to the title, excerpt and card body of each entry.

attributes.label: Media Layout
attributes.help: Choose whether the image sits inline or as a background.

attributes.label: Item background colour
attributes.help: Only the rgb values are used for rendering. The remaining keys are kept for compatibility with the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Display Item Overlay
attributes.help: Lay a colour over the background image of each entry.

attributes.label: Item overlay colour
attributes.help: Drawn as a layer above the background image of each entry while the overlay switch above is on. Only the rgb values are used for rendering.

attributes.label: Show background
attributes.help: Turns on the background layer below — its color, overlay and alignment fields only take effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Background color
attributes.help: Only the rgb values are used for rendering. The remaining keys are kept for compatibility with the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Show overlay
attributes.help: Turns on the overlay layer, drawn above the background color. The overlay color below only takes effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Overlay color
attributes.help: Drawn as a layer above the background color. Like the background color, only the rgb values are used for rendering.

attributes.label: Horizontal background alignment
attributes.help: Aligns the background layer within its row when the background column width is narrower than the full row. Has no visible effect at full width.

attributes.label: Exclude pattern
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. A pattern is only rendered when the filter crea_bootstrap_blocks_background_pattern supplies one.

attributes.label: Change pattern color
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin, where it makes the background pattern use the color below. A pattern is only rendered when the filter crea_bootstrap_blocks_background_pattern supplies one.

attributes.label: Pattern color
attributes.help: Color of the background pattern, used while the switch above is on. A pattern is only rendered when the filter crea_bootstrap_blocks_background_pattern supplies one.

attributes.label: Background utilities
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render utility classes — neither does the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Text utilities
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render utility classes — neither does the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Border utilities
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render utility classes — neither does the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Exclude divider
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only the Lightspeed theme evaluates it; this plugin stores the value and renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Exclude transition
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only the Lightspeed theme evaluates it; this plugin stores the value and renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Exclude parallax
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only the Lightspeed theme evaluates it; this plugin stores the value and renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Block ID
attributes.help: Unique identifier of this block. It links the block to its generated inline CSS and must not be changed.
